title: A photorealistic natural vertical photo
prompt:
A photorealistic natural vertical photo of a fictional 20-year-old adult Japanese woman, clearly adult-looking, natural candid off-shot style with a tasteful clean magazine gravure mood. She is lying on her back on a cream-colored sofa or soft bed, surrounded by a fluffy beige blanket, photographed from a slightly high top-down angle in a vertical composition.

She has long soft brown hair spread loosely around her head, a top Japanese idol-like tanuki face, an extremely cute round soft face, soft cheeks, round gentle eyes mostly hidden by her arms, a small natural nose, soft natural lips, and a shy relaxed expression. Her face is partially covered by both forearms and oversized sleeves, as if she is blocking bright light or feeling slightly embarrassed, creating a casual private off-shot feeling.

She wears an oversized light gray sweatshirt with a black vintage-style illustration printed across the front. The sweatshirt is loose and naturally wrinkled, with soft thick cotton fabric, oversized sleeves, and a relaxed fit. The hem of the sweatshirt is slightly lifted by her lying posture, showing a natural slim waist and softly toned abdomen without exaggeration. She also wears simple black string bikini bottoms or minimal black swimwear bottoms at the hips, with thin side ties visible in a tasteful way. Her upper body is mostly covered by the sweatshirt, so the bust is not emphasized.

Her pose is relaxed and candid: lying diagonally on the sofa, arms folded over her eyes, elbows bent, shoulders relaxed, torso slightly angled, hips naturally resting on the blanket, legs cropped out of frame. The mood is intimate but clean, calm, lazy morning atmosphere, soft natural indoor light, realistic shadows, gentle warm tones, natural skin texture, realistic pores, slight imperfections, natural facial asymmetry, not overly symmetrical, not plastic skin, not overly retouched. High detail, realistic smartphone-like candid photography, soft background, no text, no watermark.
